branding_rules: Never display OSINTNER text, logo, brand name, watermark or social handle in generated images
No text, letters, numbers, pseudo-text or random symbols in generated images
One image per one Threads post
Every image must clearly and specifically represent the exact topic of its post
Use only the approved palette and restrained vector editorial visual language

rules: No text or typography in generated visuals; the post description is published as the caption in the same Threads post
No brand name, logo, watermark or signature

consistency_rule: Every editorial Threads post contains exactly one topic-specific vector image and one Russian caption in the same post. Flat premium investigative editorial vector style. Strict palette #0B0D0F #15181B #E7E9EA #858B91 with accent #FF5A36 and rare verification green #A7D65C. No text of any kind, no logos, no watermark. Never create a carousel for an editorial material.
